meaning.en: One who hides oneself or a thing.
meaning.vi: Một người che giấu bản thân hoặc một điều gì đó.

sentences.en: We have shifted several times since, and she has always been a hider.

sentences.en: If the person who is It kicks the can, the hider "goes to jail," but if the hider kicks the can, he gets to go find a new hiding place while the person who is It counts again.

sentences.en: If the hider is the one to kick the can, all the people in jail are released to run and hide again.

sentences.en: The Slender Thighs, Hip Hider and Tummy Thinner bathing suits all contain slenderizing features in some of the hottest fashion colors and styles.

sentences.en: If, however, the seeker tags the hider before kicking the can or any of the hiders who are running to hide after the can is kicked, she must return to base to await another opportunity.

sentences.en: Clocky never rolls to the same spot two times in a row and is a good hider.

sentences.en: Whether they go by the name bra strap hider or bra control clip, these little handy items are designed to the same thing, hide your bra straps.
